mergedParams.userDescription: Text rotating on its Y-axis, 3D card flip effect.

output.title: 3D Card Flip - Y-Axis Text Rotation Effect

prompts.prompt: Create a classic 3D card flip preset that rotates text on its Y-axis, mimicking the physical motion of flipping a playing card. Think of this as a two-sided reveal effect where the front face shows the initial text and the back face reveals transformed or different content. The animation should feel smooth and natural, like you're watching a card being flipped in slow motion in a video. Use a perspective container to enhance the 3D depth, making the rotation feel genuinely three-dimensional. The flip should have a slight bounce at the end, similar to how a physical card settles after being flipped. Consider adding a subtle shadow that moves with the rotation to enhance the depth perception. The text on both sides should scale slightly during the flip to create a more dynamic feel, getting smaller at the 90-degree mark and returning to full size.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative preserve-3d' for 3D space, containing two TextAtom children positioned with 'absolute inset-0 backface-hidden'. Front face uses default rotation, back face uses 'rotate-y-180'. Apply perspective to parent with style={{perspective: '1000px'}}. Animation: Use generic effects with rotateY from 0 to 180 degrees over 0.6s with ease-in-out easing. Add scale effect from 1 to 0.85 at midpoint, back to 1. Shadow effect using filter property with drop-shadow animation. Tailwind: Container uses 'relative w-full h-full', text atoms use 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-4xl font-bold'. Performance: Use will-change: transform on animated elements. Consider using two separate TextAtoms with visibility toggling at 90 degrees for cleaner back-face handling.

prompts.prompt: Design a continuous carousel-style Y-axis rotation where text perpetually spins like a rotating billboard or slot machine reel. This creates an endless loop effect perfect for displaying multiple text items in sequence. Think of it as editing multiple text clips on a cylindrical timeline that rotates to reveal each one. The rotation should be smooth and hypnotic, with each text element appearing to curve around an invisible cylinder. Add a subtle fade effect at the edges to simulate depth of field, where text appears to fade as it moves away from the viewer. The speed should be adjustable but default to a comfortable reading pace that allows viewers to absorb each text element.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with multiple TextAtom children arranged in a circular pattern using transform: rotateY calculations. Each child offset by (360/itemCount) degrees. Container needs 'relative preserve-3d overflow-hidden'. Animation: Continuous rotateY animation from 0 to 360 degrees, looping infinitely. Each TextAtom has opacity effect based on its rotation angle (1 when facing forward, 0.3 when rotated away). Use translateZ to push items out from center for cylinder effect. Tailwind: Container 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden', items 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center'. Effects: Create internal effect preset 'carousel-rotate' with continuous rotation. Add blur effect for items not facing forward using filter property. Timing: Use fitDurationTo: 'parent' with loop behavior for continuous rotation.

prompts.prompt: Build a interactive-feeling hover-style flip effect where text appears to respond to an invisible cursor, rotating on Y-axis with acceleration and deceleration curves that mimic user interaction. Even though this is for video, create the illusion of interactivity by having the text flip at specific beats or moments. The flip should start slowly, accelerate through the middle, and decelerate to a stop, like a user quickly swiping a card. Add a subtle glow effect during the flip to draw attention, and include a slight Z-axis wobble to make it feel less mechanical and more organic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Single BaseLayout with TextAtom child, both configured for 3D transforms. Use containerProps.style for perspective: '800px'. Animation: Complex rotateY animation with custom easing curve - slow start (0-20%), fast middle (20-80%), slow end (80-100%). Add subtle rotateZ wobble (-2 to 2 degrees) during flip. Glow effect using textShadow animation synced with rotation. Tailwind: 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' for container, 'text-5xl font-extrabold transition-all' for text. Effects: Chain multiple effects - primary rotateY with spring easing, secondary rotateZ with sine wave pattern, textShadow for glow. Consider audio-reactive trigger using waveform effects if audio track present.

prompts.prompt: Create a split-flap display effect where text rotates on Y-axis in segments, like an airport departure board or vintage train station sign. Each character or word flips independently with slight timing offsets, creating a cascading flip effect. The rotation should include a mechanical feel with sharp acceleration and deceleration, mimicking the physical constraints of actual split-flap displays. Add subtle sound-sync opportunities where each flip could align with audio beats if available. Include a slight shake or vibration at the end of each flip to simulate the mechanical settling of physical flaps.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with childrenProps targeting multiple TextAtom children (one per character/word). Use repeatChildrenProps for staggered animations. If using caption data, map each word to separate TextAtom with word-level timing. Animation: Individual rotateY animations per character with staggered delays (50-100ms offset). Sharp easing curve (cubic-bezier for mechanical feel). Small translateY shake at animation end. Tailwind: Container 'flex flex-row gap-1', each character 'inline-block preserve-3d'. Effects: Create internal effect preset 'split-flap-flip' with rotateY and shake. Use generic effects with AnimationRange for precise timing control. If caption data available, sync flips to word.relativeStart times. Performance: Limit concurrent animations using animation-delay staggering.

prompts.prompt: Develop a holographic text rotation effect that simulates a futuristic AR/VR interface. The text should rotate on Y-axis while simultaneously shifting through iridescent colors and adding scan lines or glitch effects during the rotation. Think of this as editing a sci-fi movie title sequence where the text exists in 3D space with digital artifacts. The rotation should feel weightless and smooth, with occasional digital distortions that add character. Include a subtle parallax effect where different parts of the text rotate at slightly different speeds, creating depth layers.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Nested BaseLayout components for layering effects. Main text in TextAtom with duplicate semi-transparent layers offset in Z-space. Use ShapeAtom overlays for scan lines. Animation: Primary rotateY 0-360 with smooth easing. Color animation through HSL values for iridescent effect. Glitch effects using translateX/Y with random values at specific keyframes. Parallax achieved through different rotation speeds on layers. Tailwind: 'relative preserve-3d' container, layers use 'absolute inset-0 mix-blend-screen opacity-70'. Effects: Combine rotateY with color shifts using filter: hue-rotate. Add chromatic aberration using multiple text layers with slight color channel offsets. Use waveform effects for glitch triggers if audio present. Consider using Lottie animations for scan line overlays.

prompts.prompt: Design a book page flip effect where text rotates on Y-axis with realistic paper physics. The text should appear written on a page that flips naturally, with the rotation including subtle curl and shadow effects that make it feel like actual paper. The flip should start with a slight lift (translateZ), then rotate while curving naturally, and settle with a gentle bounce. Think of this as compositing text onto a 3D page model in video post-production. Add ambient occlusion-style shadows that change based on the rotation angle.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with curved surface simulation using multiple thin TextAtom slices. Each slice has slightly different rotation timing for page curl effect. Use clip-path for page shape. Animation: Complex Y-rotation with initial Z-translation for lift. Each text slice rotates with slight delay creating curl. Shadow uses filter: drop-shadow with dynamic blur and opacity based on rotation angle. Tailwind: Container 'relative preserve-3d', slices 'absolute w-full' with calculated top positions. Effects: Primary rotateY with custom cubic-bezier for paper weight feel. Secondary translateZ for lift. Filter effects for realistic shadows. Use transform-origin variations for natural pivot point. Performance: Use CSS custom properties for dynamic shadow calculations.

prompts.prompt: Create a spinning prism effect where text rotates continuously on Y-axis while refracting into rainbow colors at certain angles, similar to light passing through a crystal in a music video. The text should appear to have multiple faces like a geometric prism, with each face catching and reflecting light differently. The rotation should be smooth but include moments where the text 'catches' the light and creates dramatic color bursts or lens flares. This effect would be perfect for emphasis moments synced to musical beats or dramatic reveals.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with multiple TextAtom faces arranged in prism formation (3-6 faces). Each face rotated at specific angles around Y-axis. Use blend modes for light interaction. Animation: Continuous rotateY with periodic speed variations. Color effects triggered at specific rotation angles using HSL manipulation. Lens flare created with additional ShapeAtom overlays with radial gradients. Tailwind: 'relative preserve-3d w-full h-full', faces 'absolute inset-0 mix-blend-overlay'. Effects: Base rotation with sine-wave speed variations. Color shifts using filter animations. Brightness peaks at specific angles. If audio available, use waveform effects to trigger color bursts on beats. Consider fetcher for audio analysis to identify impactful moments.

prompts.prompt: Build a retro TV channel-switching effect where text flips on Y-axis with analog video distortion, simulating the look of changing channels on an old CRT television. The flip should include horizontal scan lines, color separation, and brief static moments. Think of this as recreating vintage video editing effects where the text appears on different 'channels' as it rotates. Add phosphor glow and slight image retention to complete the CRT aesthetic. The timing should feel slightly unpredictable, like manually turning a channel dial.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with TextAtom wrapped in distortion containers. Overlay ShapeAtom elements for scan lines and static. Use multiple text layers for RGB color separation. Animation: Stepped rotateY animation (not smooth) to simulate channel clicks. Brief opacity:0 moments for static. RGB layers with slight offset animations. Scan lines using repeating linear gradients. Tailwind: 'relative overflow-hidden bg-black', text 'font-mono text-green-400' for terminal look. Effects: RotateY with step timing function. Filter effects for blur and contrast during switch. Transform skewX for brief distortion. Static effect using rapidly changing opacity on noise overlay. Performance: Use CSS animations for scan lines to offload from main thread.

prompts.prompt: Design a magical card reveal effect where text rotates on Y-axis with particle effects and ethereal glow, like a spell being cast in a fantasy video game cutscene. The rotation should feel otherworldly, with the text leaving light trails as it spins and mystical particles orbiting around it. The flip should accelerate mysteriously, pause at 90 degrees for dramatic effect, then complete with a burst of sparkles. Think of this as combining practical card magic with digital VFX enhancement.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with main TextAtom and multiple ShapeAtom particles. Particles positioned absolutely and animated independently. Light trails created with duplicated text layers with motion blur. Animation: Three-phase rotateY - accelerate to 90deg, pause, complete rotation. Particles use circular translateX/Y paths with varying radiuses. Glow increases at 90deg mark. Sparkle burst using multiple small ShapeAtoms with scale/opacity animations. Tailwind: 'relative preserve-3d', particles 'absolute w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-gradient-radial'. Effects: Main rotation with custom easing. Particle orbits using combined translateX/Y with sine/cosine calculations. TextShadow for magical glow. Consider LottieAtom for complex particle effects. Timing: Use pause at midpoint with setTimeout or keyframe holds.

prompts.prompt: Create a sports replay-style rotation where text flips on Y-axis with motion blur and speed lines, mimicking high-speed camera work from sports broadcasts. The rotation should start in slow motion, accelerate to real-time speed, then return to slow motion at the end, like a dramatic instant replay. Add dynamic motion blur that increases with rotation speed and speed lines that emphasize the movement. Include a subtle camera shake at the peak rotation speed to enhance the intensity. Think of this as the kind of text effect used for player names or statistics in sports highlight reels.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with TextAtom and motion effect overlays. Speed lines using multiple thin ShapeAtom elements or CSS gradients. Motion blur via filter or duplicated layers. Animation: Variable-speed rotateY using keyframes with timing changes - slow (0-30%), fast (30-70%), slow (70-100%). Motion blur intensity linked to rotation speed. Speed lines fade in/out based on velocity. Camera shake using small translateX/Y at peak speed. Tailwind: 'relative preserve-3d overflow-visible', speed lines 'absolute h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white to-transparent'. Effects: RotateY with complex easing curve. Filter: blur() animated in sync with rotation speed. Speed lines use translateX with different delays. Shake effect using rapid translateX/Y oscillation. Performance: Pre-calculate motion blur frames for smoother playback.
